GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm: the vulnerable code is launch-editor, which vite 5.4.21 bundles into its dist rather than resolving as a package — so it is absent from pnpm-lock.yaml while escapeCmdArgs, launchEditor and guessEditor are all present in dist/node/chunks/dep-BK3b2jBa.js, reachable through the dev server's __open-in-editor endpoint. Because the code is inlined, a pnpm override cannot substitute a patched launch-editor; the fix for the 5.x line is vite 6.4.4, gated on vitepress 2.x. Accepted rather than dismissed: exposure requires a developer to be running 'vitepress dev' locally, all three vectors are Windows-specific, vite 5.4.21 reaches this repo only as a transitive dev dependency of the documentation site (the prod audit is clean), and the workspace's other vite is 8.3.4, above the 8.3.3 fix. Revisit when vitepress 2.x lands.
